prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post adoption certificate sign-in reorder flow: Moves sign-in screen to take place right after adoption certificate completion, before the waiting phase.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
1: [home, new_flow] Pet personality setup sub-flow during wait: Adds an interactive personality trait customization sub-flow while waiting for the pet to render.
   config: {"waiting": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_personality", "home_intro"]}, "new_pet_personality": {"headline": "Tune Your Pet Personality", "body": "Select key temperament traits for your pet while we finish setup.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select traits", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet habitat environment selection new screen: Inserts a habitat theme selection screen into the adoption flow before photos or certificate.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_habitat_select", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_habitat_select": {"headline": "Select Pet Sanctuary Theme", "body": "Choose the default desktop cozy corner theme for your new friend.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Sanctuary", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop companion launchpad redesign for home intro: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight launchpad layout featuring a mascot highlight and clear launch button.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Click launch to summon your pet directly onto your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_hero", "style": "large"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Launch to Desktop", "action": "next", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account pet save clarity headline on sign-in: Updates sign-in headline and body to highlight pet backup and progress preservation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet & Progress", "body": "Link your account now so your pet configuration and traits are backed up safely."}}
5: [adoption, layout] Grid pet selection layout on pick friend screen: Switches pick_friend screen layout to a visual grid format for quick pet side-by-side comparison.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion"}}
6: [home, wait_info] Rendering progress stage checklist for waiting screen: Replaces waiting status text with an active multi-stage checklist showing pet creation stages.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "checklist", "text": "Building 3D model, preparing desktop animations", "style": "plain"}]}}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Naming pet adoption milestone reward badge: Adds an unlocked companion trait reward badge to the adoption certificate screen upon naming the pet.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocked Special Companion Trait", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, hint] Desktop pet interaction quick key hint: Displays a clear hint on home_intro explaining shortcut controls and context menu options for the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open controls, talk, or hide."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop ready audio notification on waiting screen: Triggers an audio completion notification sound when pet rendering finishes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:completion_chime", "style": "plain"}]}}
